text_block_list.text:
As I stayed up late into the night
thinking about Special Week's training—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion...
Trainer, I had a feeling you'd be here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I went to your room to share some carrots my mom sent me, but you weren't there—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I came by thinking you might still be working,
and it turns out..."
Saying that, Special Week peered down at my hands.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, my training menu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You've been working for my sake
until this late hour, haven't you?
choice_data_list: Because I want to lead you to victory.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're always doing so much for me...
Always caring for me so deeply...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, please let me do something too!
Should I go run along the riverbank?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best to win too!
I just can't sit still!
choice_data_list: Then it's time for extra training.
Get some good rest and let's prepare for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best to win too!
I just can't sit still!
choice_data_list: Then it's time for extra training.
Get some good rest and let's prepare for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Yes!!
I look forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Could this be new training!?
I wonder what we're doing... I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, I'm still in my uniform!
Ahaha, I'll go get changed right away~!

Afterward, Special Week kept running full speed on the night track,
as if letting all her emotions burst out.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You mean we're doing nothing?
But preparing for tomorrow means...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see! So we're starting the training
you're planning tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Understood! In that case, I'm heading straight back to the dorm to sleep right away!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Put me through the wringer tomorrow, okay?!
Well then!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Oops, good night, Trainer!
Training time the next day—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-san!
Come on, let's get training started!
choice_data_list: Why are you wearing your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, somehow I ended up totally pumped up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, look at me.
This is what the Umamusume you trained looks like."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I came to this academy from Hokkaido,
and look how splendidly I've grown up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's because I met Trainer
that I'm able to run like this. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely show you I can become the best Umamusume in Japan!
choice_data_list: I'll keep supporting you until your dream comes true!
I'll keep supporting you until your dream comes true, okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, please take care of me!! All right, I'm gonna give it my all today too, don'tcha know!

The surrounding Umamusume cheer on
Special Week in her eye-catching outfit—

It truly looked as though she were being hailed
as the greatest Umamusume in Japan.
